sets.question: Where should I put these shipping labels?

choices.B: On the shelf next to the printer.
choices.C: Yes, I ordered more last week.

zh.q: 这些货运标签应该放哪里？

opts.B: 放在打印机旁边的架子上。
opts.C: 是的，我上周又订了一些。

zh.rationale: Where 问地点，B 给位置。A 说时间，C 答 yes/no，均不对应。

sets.question: Has the client approved the revised proposal?

choices.A: Not yet — they're still reviewing it.

zh.q: 客户批准修订后的方案了吗？
zh.rationale: Has…? 是一般疑问，A 直接回应审批进度。B 像答时间，C 答地点。

sets.question: Who is covering the front desk this afternoon?

zh.rationale: Who 问人，C 点名 Marco。A 时间、B 路线无关。
